_comment: Maps finder families to the risk in your ThreatModel register that a finding belongs to. Inert until you ratify it: set ratified_by (your name) and ratified_at (an ISO date) at the top level, then add rules such as { "source": "manual", "risk_ref": "R-001" } or, for a scanner family, { "source": "workflows-scanner", "family": "tls", "risk_ref": "R-002" }. Every risk_ref must exist in SECURITY/THREATMODEL/risk-register.json or the rule is dropped.
